name: K&B Outreach — 1. Outbound Dispatcher & Schema Engine

nodes.name: Every Business Day 08:00
nodes.notes: Mon-Fri 08:00 in the n8n instance timezone. Holidays are filtered in Init Config.

nodes.name: Init Config
nodes.notes: Reads every env var, validates it, and decides whether today is a send day.

nodes.name: Is Today a Send Day?
nodes.notes: Weekend / holiday / outside the send window -> stop cleanly.

nodes.name: Get Base Schema
nodes.notes: Metadata API. PAT needs schema.bases:read.

nodes.name: Plan Schema Changes
nodes.notes: Diffs live schema vs. required. Emits only CREATE-field and additive choice PATCHes.

nodes.name: Loop Schema Changes
nodes.notes: Output 0 = done (fires once), output 1 = one pending change.

nodes.name: Is a Change?
nodes.notes: The plan summary rides through the loop with the calls; skip it here.

nodes.name: Apply Schema Change
nodes.notes: PAT needs schema.bases:write. Creates fields and adds select choices; never deletes or retypes.

nodes.name: Schema Report
nodes.notes: Runs once. Aborts the run if any planned change failed.

nodes.name: Fetch Candidate Leads
nodes.notes: Paginated. filterByFormula already excludes Replied / Do Not Contact / Invalid.

nodes.name: Build Send Queue
nodes.notes: Eligibility + business-day gates + dedupe + 30/day cap + 15-20 min stagger.

nodes.name: Loop Over Leads
nodes.notes: One lead at a time. Output 0 = done, output 1 = loop.

nodes.name: Stagger 15-20 min
nodes.notes: Randomized per-lead delay computed in Build Send Queue. First lead waits 0s.

nodes.name: Re-read Lead Record
nodes.notes: SAFETY: re-read immediately before sending, so a reply that landed during the stagger wins.

nodes.name: Guard: Re-read & Re-check
nodes.notes: Blocks the send if the record went terminal, already advanced, or was already sent today.

nodes.name: Verify Email (MillionVerifier)
nodes.notes: Key travels in the query string per MillionVerifier v3. Failures fall through as data.

nodes.name: Verification Gate
nodes.notes: ok -> send. catch_all/unknown -> Risky. invalid/disposable -> Invalid. API error -> defer, status untouched.

nodes.name: Route by Touch
nodes.notes: The multi-stage sending switch. Status already decided which touch is due.

nodes.name: Case: Email 1 (Day 1)
nodes.notes: Status New/blank -> touch 1.

nodes.name: Case: Follow-up 1 (Day 4)
nodes.notes: Status Sent Email 1 + >= 3 business days.

nodes.name: Case: Follow-up 2 (Day 8)
nodes.notes: Status Sent Follow-up 1 + >= 4 business days.

nodes.name: Build Email
nodes.notes: Plain text, no tracking. Follow-ups carry In-Reply-To / References.

nodes.name: Send via Postmark
nodes.notes: Header credential: X-Postmark-Server-Token. See docs/RUNBOOK.md for the SMTP variant.

nodes.name: Parse Send Result
nodes.notes: Reconstructs the RFC Message-ID (<uuid@mtasv.net>) so follow-ups can thread.

nodes.name: Build Airtable Commit
nodes.notes: One PATCH per lead for every outcome: sent / invalid / failed / skipped.

nodes.name: Commit to Airtable
nodes.notes: Status + Last Contacted Date + Idempotency Key in ONE write. typecast:true lets a text Status column work too.

nodes.name: Post Run Summary to Slack
nodes.notes: Slack incoming webhook. Optional — leave SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL empty to skip.

parameters.content:
## Workflow 1 — Outbound Dispatcher & Schema Engine

**Flow:** schedule → config/preflight → Airtable schema check & auto-create → fetch eligible leads → build the capped, staggered queue → per lead: wait → **re-read** → guard → verify → switch by touch → send → commit.

**Two safety guarantees**
1. `filterByFormula` never even loads a `Replied` / `Do Not Contact` / `Invalid` record.
2. Every lead is re-read from Airtable *immediately before* its send, so a reply that arrives during the 15-20 min stagger still cancels the email.

**Do not edit Code nodes here.** They are generated from `src/` by `npm run build`.

### Daily cap
30/day, enforced in **Build Send Queue** — after dedupe, before the loop. Follow-ups are sent before new leads, so a backlog never starves live threads. Overflow rolls to the next business day.

### Failure policy
`Send via Postmark` and `Commit to Airtable` continue on error.

- **Send failed** → `Last Error` written, **Status unchanged** → retried next run.
- **Verifier down** → lead deferred, **Status unchanged**. An outage never burns a lead.
- **Verified Invalid/Risky** → `Status = Invalid`, lead halted.
